profile.content: My name is Shokri. I’m a Technical Product Owner from Ireland based in Berlin for the past 10 years, with a background in software engineering and hands-on experience building digital and AI-powered products end-to-end. I work at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations — owning problem definition, prioritization, and delivery, while staying close to implementation. My focus is on turning complex technical capabilities into clear, usable products, particularly in regulated and high-trust domains. This portfolio highlights selected product work, with a focus on ownership, decision-making, and delivery.
